import numpy as np
from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

X, y = load_breast_cancer(return_X_y=True)        # u lành tính (1) hay ác tính (0)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=0, stratify=y)

scaler = StandardScaler().fit(X_train)             # chỉ học thang đo từ TRAIN
Xs_train, Xs_test = scaler.transform(X_train), scaler.transform(X_test)

clf = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000).fit(Xs_train, y_train)
print("accuracy:", round(clf.score(Xs_test, y_test), 3))

proba = clf.predict_proba(Xs_test)[:, 1]            # xác suất lớp 1
print(proba[:3].round(3), clf.predict(Xs_test)[:3])

import numpy as np
from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

X, y = load_breast_cancer(return_X_y=True)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=0, stratify=y)
scaler = StandardScaler().fit(X_train)
Xs_train, Xs_test = scaler.transform(X_train), scaler.transform(X_test)
clf = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000).fit(Xs_train, y_train)

def sigmoid(z):
    return 1 / (1 + np.exp(-z))

w, b = clf.coef_[0], clf.intercept_[0]
proba_manual = sigmoid(Xs_test @ w + b)
print(np.allclose(proba_manual, clf.predict_proba(Xs_test)[:, 1]))

from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline

X, y = load_breast_cancer(return_X_y=True)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=0, stratify=y)
pipe = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000))
pipe.fit(X_train, y_train)
acc = pipe.score(X_test, y_test)
print(round(acc, 3))
